question:
Select the most appropriate option to substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Shantanu always __buries his head in the sand__ whenever he explains his professional failures to his father.

options.text: blames the others for his mistakes
shows a blind eye against social issues

solution:
The correct option is '**Option 2**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The phrase** 'bury one's head in the sand' **means to try to avoid a situation which is rather unpleasant by pretending that the problem doesn't exist. (मुसीबतों से आँख मूंद लेना)

 
 
• **Example**- Live with it or** bury your head in the sand.**
 
 
 
• Hence we can infer that the most approprate option will be** 'Option 2'.**

Therefore, the correct answer is '**Hides from the truth**'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are other options explained along with their Hindi meaning and example sentences.

 
• **"To show a blind eye/to turn a blind eye" in 'Option 4'**(जानबूझकर ध्यान नहीं देना ): To ignore something that you know is wrong.

 It has the almost same meaning as that of 'Option 2', however, "Option 4" will not be appropriate as per the context of the passage.

 
• **Example- **Teachers are turning a blind eye to pupils smoking at school.**​ **
